name: v2-pause-resume
review: Both X10 moves produce 800 steps; the configured 10 mm/s speed and 100 mm/s² acceleration predict the recorded 109,859-tick last-pulse durations within one 10 microsecond tick. Player.cpp registers M600 and M601 and emits the required host pause and resume messages. Both real firmware revisions reproduced the trace and messages. This case does not test host cooperation or commands sent while paused, so the inherited pause scenario remains pending. Physical operation is unverified.
